name: shampoo-scout
description: Compare wash labels and track actual use.

interface.longDescription: Compare wash labels and track actual use. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare shampoo label declarations; Inspect your wash schedule; Compare cost per wash. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare shampoo label declarations.
Help me inspect your wash schedule.

prompts: Help me compare shampoo label declarations.
Help me inspect your wash schedule.
Help me compare cost per wash.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Lather Lens: Shampoo workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Compare shampoo label declarations. Reproducible inputs: {"products":[{"name":"Shampoo A","ingredients":["water","fragrance"]},{"name":"Shampoo B","ingredients":["water","glycerin"]}],"avoid":["fragrance"]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare shampoo label declarations with these supplied values: {"products":[{"name":"Shampoo A","ingredients":["water","fragrance"]},{"name":"Shampoo B","ingredients":["water","glycerin"]}],"avoid":["fragrance"]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses shampoo_scout_shampoo_labels with the supplied inputs. Returns {"products":[{"name":"Shampoo A","ingredients":["water","fragrance"],"matches":["fragrance"],"not_listed":[]},{"name":"Shampoo B","ingredients":["water","glycerin"],"matches":[],"not_listed":["fragrance"]}],"note":"Not listed is not proof of absence; aliases, concentrations and contamination are not checked."}. Shows the actual labels result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Inspect your wash schedule. Reproducible inputs: {"dates":["2026-10-28","2026-10-31","2026-11-04"]}
positive.prompt: Help me inspect your wash schedule with these supplied values: {"dates":["2026-10-28","2026-10-31","2026-11-04"]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses shampoo_scout_wash_intervals with the supplied inputs. Returns {"intervals":[{"from":"2026-10-28","to":"2026-10-31","days":3},{"from":"2026-10-31","to":"2026-11-04","days":4}],"average_days":3.5,"note":"Describes your supplied dates; does not prescribe wash frequency."}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare cost per wash. Reproducible inputs: {"options":[{"name":"Bottle A","price":12,"volume_ml":300,"dose_ml":10},{"name":"Bottle B","price":20,"volume_ml":500,"dose_ml":8}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare cost per wash with these supplied values: {"options":[{"name":"Bottle A","price":12,"volume_ml":300,"dose_ml":10},{"name":"Bottle B","price":20,"volume_ml":500,"dose_ml":8}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses shampoo_scout_bottle_value with the supplied inputs. Returns {"options":[{"name":"Bottle B","price":20,"volume_ml":500,"dose_ml":8,"estimated_washes":62.5,"cost_per_wash":0.32},{"name":"Bottle A","price":12,"volume_ml":300,"dose_ml":10,"estimated_washes":30,"cost_per_wash":0.4}]}. Shows the actual budget result. Does not fabricate external data.
